title: Grant proposal assembly
description: Assemble an evidence-backed grant application and score it against the supplied rubric.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: grant-proposal-assembly
  title: Grant proposal assembly
  description: Assemble an evidence-backed grant application and score it against the supplied rubric.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Assemble an evidence-backed grant application and score it against the supplied rubric.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - approval
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Source material and instructions
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - asset
          - instructions
        properties:
          asset:
            type: string
            contentMediaType: application/pdf
          instructions:
            type: string
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: role-1
      kind: agent
      name: Grant Program Officer
      templateRef: pub-05
      role: Grant Program Officer operating within supplied evidence, policy, and human-approval boundaries.
      prompt: Evaluate eligibility, public purpose, evidence, milestones, budget allowability, and reporting
        obligations consistently.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - compliance-review
          - evaluation
          - finance-analysis
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-2
      kind: agent
      name: Past-Performance Evidence Curator
      templateRef: pub-03
      role: Past-Performance Evidence Curator operating within supplied evidence, policy, and human-approval
        boundaries.
      prompt: Select only relevant, permitted past-performance evidence and trace every claim to an approved record.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evidence-verification
          - research
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-3
      kind: agent
      name: Academic & Research Writing Coach
      templateRef: write-05
      role: Academic and research writing coach
      prompt: Sharpen the thesis into a specific arguable claim and ensure each section builds evidence toward it.
        Enforce the requested register and citation style, flag unsupported claims, address counterarguments,
        and make the conclusion synthesize what was established.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - design-review
          - evidence-verification
        tools:
          - read
          - edit
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:academic-research
          - mcp:zotero
          - mcp:document-editor
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: work-group
      kind: group
      name: Bounded specialist phase
      config:
        members:
          - role-1
          - role-2
          - role-3
        execution: parallel
        exit: aggregate
    - id: teacher
      kind: teacher
      name: Independent rubric review
      role: Host-resolved teacher model
      prompt: Apply the supplied rubric consistently, cite specific evidence, and return actionable feedback without
        silently rewriting the work.
      inlineRole: true
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
      config:
        teacherModel: host:teacher-model
        feedbackMode: rubric
    - id: assemble
      kind: aggregator
      name: Assemble ordered sections
      config:
        aggregation: concat
    - id: approval
      kind: approval
      name: Accountable domain reviewer approves release
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable and unresolved-item register
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: work-group
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: work-group
      to: assemble
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: assemble
      to: teacher
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: teacher
      to: approval
      kind: dependency
    - id: e5
      from: approval
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
